name: Bicep Curl (Strict)
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall or post, feet a little way out in front of you.
Hold the bar at arm's length with an underhand grip, elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up without letting your elbows drift forward or your back leave the wall.
Lower all the way down under control. No swing: if your back comes off the wall, the weight is too heavy.
